description: Source code for Odoo module related to project management, including classes for contexts, timeboxes, and tasks with custom view logic.

classes.name: one2many_mod
classes.description: Custom one2many field with overridden get method for context-based retrieval.

classes.name: project_gtd_context
classes.description: Model representing project contexts with sequence and default project.

classes.name: project_gtd_timebox
classes.description: Model representing timeboxes with multiple tasks and dynamic view generation.

classes.name: project_task
classes.description: Extension of project.task with additional fields for timebox and context, and custom copy behavior.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Custom get method for one2many_mod to retrieve related task IDs based on context.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Overrides view generation to create dynamic form views for timeboxes.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Resets timebox and context fields when copying a task.

methods.name: _get_context
methods.description: Retrieves default context ID for a task.
